**Analyzing solid structure**

I’m looking at the main solid with sprocket and spokes. I need to assign face ranges, which is probably crucial here. I could create a list of selective faces, maybe even all of them, using compact only IDs for the geometry. This feels like a good starting point to ensure everything is organized properly! I’m curious about how to set those assignments effectively. Let’s explore that process further!
**Considering data representation**

I need to include representative faces, perhaps as individual objects with ID labels that contain explicit sets. The schema allows for strings, so I'll want to ensure I'm using range notation and the appropriate semantic roles. It's essential to structure this data clearly so that each component is easily identifiable and linked correctly. This approach will help in managing the information efficiently!
**Planning function structure**

I'm focusing on creating detailed sections and functions while omitting "relative location" from the schema. I want to encode this in the section names and function descriptions. Adjacency ordering will help me arrange each feature list in sequence, like a geometric walk. I might need to list ranges and incorporate numeric confidence levels. Overall, it's important that everything is valid JSON, so I'll ensure that every part adheres to that format.

part.name: bicycle cassette sprocket with separate splined center insert

part_functions.name: chain torque transmission
part_functions.function: The circumferential sprocket teeth engage a bicycle chain and transmit tangential chain load through the reinforced rim and spoke web to the central driver interface.

part_functions.name: rotary mounting interface
part_functions.function: The central internally splined insert couples the sprocket assembly coaxially to a matching cassette driver or hub body while resisting relative rotation.

part_functions.name: lightweight structural support
part_functions.function: Radial ribs and large windows reduce mass while maintaining torsional and radial stiffness between the center interface and toothed rim.

section_functions.name: coaxial torque coupling
section_functions.function: The separate center insert occupies the rotational axis and provides the internal spline, axial bearing faces, chamfers and an outer scalloped coupling profile. It transfers torque into the surrounding sprocket body and provides axial registration.

section_functions.name: relationship to main sprocket
section_functions.function: The insert is coaxial with the main sprocket, nested inside its center opening and retained by close radial and axial interfaces; its lobed exterior distributes torque into the main spider.

feature_functions.name: driver engagement
feature_functions.function: Repeated axial spline flanks and root surfaces engage a mating driver. Opposed flanks react circumferential torque, while the through-bore permits axial assembly.

feature_functions.name: physical behavior
feature_functions.function: Torque produces alternating bearing contact on the spline flanks. The long axial engagement distributes contact stress and limits rocking about the sprocket axis.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Contiguous repeated planar spline flanks and narrow crest lands forming the polygonal internal through-spline.
Circumferentially ordered cylindrical root segments between adjacent internal spline teeth.

features.name: insert annulus and axial seating faces

feature_functions.name: axial location
feature_functions.function: The planar annular faces seat against neighboring hardware, while the cylindrical outer wall and conical lead-in center the insert during assembly.

feature_functions.name: load distribution
feature_functions.function: The annular body spreads concentrated spline reactions into the larger lobed coupling region.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Front circumferential lead-in chamfer around the insert annulus.
Front axial annular seating face surrounding the internal spline.
Outer cylindrical register of the central insert.

features.name: scalloped outer coupling and rear flange

feature_functions.name: torque transfer to spider
feature_functions.function: The circumferentially lobed exterior creates multiple broad contact regions that transmit torque from the splined insert into the main sprocket without relying on a single key.

feature_functions.name: retention and centering
feature_functions.function: Rear planar faces, cylindrical segments and rounded transitions provide axial retention, concentric location and reduced stress concentration at the insert-to-spider junction.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Local rear axial land initiating the scalloped coupling flange.
Ordered cylindrical and blended segments defining the rear scalloped coupling perimeter.
Intermediate annular shoulder separating rear flange geometry from the deeper lobed body.
Circumferential sequence of axial sidewalls forming the multi-lobed outer insert interface.
Rear axial end face of the insert and its surrounding coupling flange.

sections.name: radial spider and open structural web

section_functions.name: radial torque distribution
section_functions.function: The spider extends from the center mount to the outer rim. Its curved radial ribs divide torque among multiple load paths and support the rim against radial and lateral deflection.

section_functions.name: mass reduction
section_functions.function: Large rounded windows remove low-stress material while preserving continuous ribs, an inner hub ring and an outer circumferential ring.

section_functions.name: feature relationships
section_functions.function: The ribs are integral and adjacent to both the center mounting ring and outer sprocket rim. The repeated ribs and windows are approximately rotationally patterned and mutually reinforcing.

features.name: curved radial spokes with weight-relief windows

feature_functions.name: structural load path
feature_functions.function: Curved spokes carry tangential chain torque as combined in-plane tension, compression and bending. Wide filleted roots reduce peak stress at the hub and rim junctions.

feature_functions.name: lateral stiffness
feature_functions.function: Finite axial thickness and raised edge transitions resist sprocket dish deformation while the openings minimize rotating mass.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Connected sidewalls and blends of the first spider sector, including a spoke edge and adjoining window boundary.
Sequential curved spoke and window surfaces extending around the upper and right-hand spider sectors.
Continuous sequence of filleted window walls, spoke edges and local axial web lands around the lower spider sectors.
Front-side spoke crowns, window perimeter blends and their connections to the inner and outer rings.
Inner spider transition and remaining circumferential web surfaces completing the connected radial load paths.

section_functions.name: insert reception
section_functions.function: The center ring surrounds the separate insert and provides a coaxial seat with repeated scalloped contact regions, axial shoulders and chamfered transitions.

section_functions.name: relationship to spider
section_functions.function: The mounting ring is integral with and reinforces the spoke roots. It receives distributed torque from the insert and feeds it into all radial ribs.

features.name: central insert-receiving recess and scalloped seat

feature_functions.name: coaxial registration
feature_functions.function: Cylindrical and planar annular surfaces locate the insert radially and axially, maintaining the sprocket centerline.

feature_functions.name: distributed torque reaction
feature_functions.function: Repeated conical and cylindrical sectors follow the lobed insert outline and distribute contact load around the circumference.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Rear-side repeated chamfers around the scalloped center seat, ordered circumferentially.
Axial scalloped seat walls contacting and centering the separate insert.
Front-side repeated lead-in chamfers around the insert-receiving profile.
Axial annular shoulder surrounding the center seat.
Circumferential outer chamfer of the center mounting ring.
Outer cylindrical register joining the center mounting ring to the spoke roots.

section_functions.name: rim support
section_functions.function: The annular rim ties all spoke ends together, distributes local tooth forces circumferentially and limits radial ovalization.

section_functions.name: chain guidance
section_functions.function: Stepped and blended circumferential surfaces guide the chain toward the tooth centerline and provide clearance around the tooth roots.

section_functions.name: relationship to teeth and spider
section_functions.function: The rim is integral and adjacent to every external tooth and every spoke end. It supports the teeth in bending and transfers their loads into the spider.

features.name: rear annular rim lands and blending surfaces

feature_functions.name: support and reinforcement
feature_functions.function: Rear annular lands, toroidal blends and curved transition surfaces thicken the tooth-root region and smoothly connect it to the open spider.

feature_functions.name: stress control
feature_functions.function: Rounded transitions spread tooth bending reactions and reduce notch sensitivity at the rim-to-web junction.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Circumferentially connected rear rim blends and local transition patches between tooth roots and the outer spider ring.
Remaining rear rim transition surfaces and annular lands approaching the spider interface.
Large rear axial annular face of the main sprocket body.

features.name: tooth-root band and circumferential side profile

feature_functions.name: tooth foundation
feature_functions.function: The root band joins adjacent chain teeth and reacts tooth bending loads before distributing them into the annular rim.

feature_functions.name: axial chain clearance
feature_functions.function: Alternating planar, cylindrical and conical surfaces shape the side profile and provide lead-in clearance for chain plates.

brep_faces.semantic_role: First ordered circumferential walk across repeated tooth-root lands, sidewalls and transition chamfers.
Continuous axial annular land underlying the repeated external tooth profile.
Second circumferential walk of root cylinders and opposing side chamfers completing the tooth foundation.

section_functions.name: chain engagement
section_functions.function: The repeated external teeth enter the chain roller gaps and convert chain tension into torque about the central axis.

section_functions.name: engagement and release behavior
section_functions.function: Tapered, rounded and relieved tooth flanks promote smooth chain entry and release. Tooth loads act primarily as circumferential bending and bearing forces at the roots.

section_functions.name: rotational pattern relationship
section_functions.function: All teeth are arranged around the same center axis and are structurally joined through the continuous root band; local surface groups repeat around the circumference.

features.name: front-side tooth flanks, tips and guide blends

feature_functions.name: chain pickup
feature_functions.function: Front-side tapered and rounded surfaces guide a chain roller into the tooth space and reduce edge interference under small alignment errors.

feature_functions.name: wear distribution
feature_functions.function: Blended flank geometry spreads contact and avoids sharp transitions at the tooth tip and root.

brep_faces.semantic_role: First complete circumferential sequence of front tooth flank blends, tip rounds and intervening guide surfaces.
Adjacent front-side tapered tooth faces and transition patches completing the repeated chain-entry profile.

features.name: rear-side tooth flanks, tips and guide blends

feature_functions.name: chain release and retention
feature_functions.function: Rear-side curved and tapered surfaces maintain roller contact during torque transfer and then permit controlled chain release.

feature_functions.name: tooth bending support
feature_functions.function: The rear flank surfaces merge through broad blends into the root band, reducing local bending stress.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Continuous rear axial annular land at the base of the external tooth array.
First complete circumferential sequence of rear tooth flank blends, tip rounds and root transitions.
Outer guide and tip surfaces forming an adjacent repeated circumferential tooth profile.
Rear tapered tooth flanks and alternating transition faces ordered around the sprocket circumference.
Final circumferential sequence of rear tip blends and chain-clearance surfaces completing the external tooth array.
